packs.name: French Core
packs.author: Max Boksem
packs.description: A short starter set: everyday nouns, a few key verbs and the words that link sentences, with grammar pages for them.

packs.name: Français · Fondations (A1)
packs.author: Max Boksem
packs.description: For a complete beginner. Greetings, the verbs you need first, numbers and time, family, food, the body and finding your way in town.

packs.name: Français · Au quotidien (A2)
packs.author: Max Boksem
packs.description: After A1. Daily routines, weather and seasons, clothes, travel, work, the doctor and shopping, plus short spoken replies.

packs.name: Français · Aisance (B1)
packs.author: Max Boksem
packs.description: After A2. Opinions, society and history, everyday idioms, false friends and the French people speak.

packs.name: Nederlands · Basis (A1)

packs.name: Nederlands · Dagelijks (A2)
